triggers.name: scheduled_worker_v2
triggers.title: Scheduled worker search
triggers.description: Scheduled worker search in ADP Workforce Now
triggers.help: Execute worker search every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes. Returns batches of workers as result.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: start_at
input.label: Start at
input.hint: Date and time to start getting ADP workers. Leave blank to start when recipe is run.

input.name: schedule_execution
input.label: Schedule execution
input.hint: Set this to true to switch to scheduled execution of the trigger. When enabled, polling interval will be replaced with the scheduled settings below.

input.name: filter
input.label: Filter
input.hint: Provide the value for the filter parameter. For example, workers/workAssignments/assignmentStatus/statusCode/codeValue eq 'A'

input.name: fields
input.label: Output fields
input.hint: Use this to define the fields returned in your output. The name of fields defined should match the API response exactly.

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.description: Custom action in ADP Workforce Now (Custom)
actions.help: Build your own ADP Workforce Now action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your ADP Workforce Now connection OAuth scopes: Scopes API

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request
